senses.gloss: m. (הדר) trimmed (and thin) beam for ornament, opp. כשורא a supporting joist.—Pl. הוּדְרֵי.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 3b:11">B. Bath. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>שרגי ליבני והדרי ה׳ וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if the officers of the congregation have had the bricks (for the new Synagogue) piled up, the beams trimmed &c.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 6a:10">Ib. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אהזיק להוּרְדֵּי וכ׳</he> if one has acquired, by the law of limitation, the right of laying beams in the neighbor’s wall, he has not the right of laying joists. [For transpos. of <cite ref="D00000"><he>ד</he></cite> a. <cite ref="T00000"><he>ר</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="M00326"><he>מִדְּרָא</he></cite>.]
